activity.notes: This is the Skidi Pawnee Petalesharo associated with rescuing a captive and with the 1821 delegation to Washington, not Petalesharo II of the later Grand Pawnee. The securely documented diplomatic visit is a representative point; no uncertain lifetime chieftainship is fabricated.
